newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Gerdau group's listed firms reveal '96 net.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Gerdau group's listed firms reveal '96 net.

text.p: Brazil's Siderurgica Riograndense posted a net profit of 54.1 million reais in 1996, local steel and metal group Grupo Gerdau said in a statement.
The group also said its holding firm Metalurgica Gerdau reported a net profit of 45.9 million reais last year, while Gerdau SA posted a net profit of 62.5 million reais in the period.
The conglomerate posted a 94 million reais net profit in 1996, an increase of 66 percent compared with its earnings in the previous year.
The group's revenues increased to 2.2 billion reais last year from 1.9 billion reais in 1995, Gerdau said in the statement.
Steel output rose to 3.5 million tonnes, eight percent over 1995, it said.
The group sold 3.2 million tonnes of steel, of which 2.2 million tonnes were to the domestic market.
It also said it exported $126 million in steel products.
